Title: Onward
Writer: Dan Scanlon, Keith Bunin, Jason Headley
Actors: Tom Holland, Chris Pratt, Julia Louis-Dreyfus
Plot: Teenage elf brothers Ian and Barley embark on a magical quest to spend one more day with their late father. Like any good adventure, their journey is filled with cryptic maps, impossible obstacles and unimaginable discoveries.
Awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 4 wins & 64 nominations total
